reading.body:
Three projects make up this collection with a combined 40,149 GitHub stars, and unlike every other repository-based category in this collection, no two of the three share the same open source licence.

pipecat leads at 15,104 stars under BSD-2-Clause, livekit's agents framework follows at 13,947 stars under Apache-2.0, and ten-framework holds 11,098 stars under a custom licence. All three describe themselves as frameworks for building realtime or conversational voice AI agents, a narrower and more consistent purpose than the broader ai-frameworks category elsewhere in this collection, yet their licensing shows no equivalent convergence.

At 40,149 combined stars, this is one of the smaller repository collections tracked here, well below the 93,964 stars behind the three agent memory projects and far below the 332,165 stars behind the four autonomous agent projects, suggesting voice and telephony agents remain an earlier-stage category by open source adoption than general-purpose or coding agents.
